title: tools.run_test request
description: Run a project-defined test command. Resolves the runner from the workspace manifest unless `argv` is provided explicitly. Only an unfiltered command discovered at the active workspace root is authoritative for a positive verdict; explicit or filtered runs are diagnostic-only.

argv.description: Explicit diagnostic command. An explicit command cannot authorize a positive verdict.

filter.description: Optional test name / path filter passed through to the runner. A filtered partial plan cannot authorize a positive verdict.
